# How much of your recorded time becomes cash?

> Free law firm realization calculator: realization, collection rate and yield per lawyer, dollars lost before and after billing, lockup days, and what a point of realization is worth. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.

- [The tool](https://duncan-haywood.github.io/oss-monorepo/law-firm-realization-rate-calculator/)
